_comment: Source URLs for this skill's reference files. Run scripts/update-references.py to refresh. Every page is fetched as Markdown through the learn.chatgpt.com '.md' twin of the page URL (developers.openai.com/codex/... redirects there).

references/config-schema.md.covers: CODEX_HOME layout, config.toml layers and precedence, profiles, project trust, top-level keys, model providers, features, notifications, telemetry, requirements.toml and managed configuration, environment variables, authentication

references/permissions.md.covers: sandbox_mode and approval_policy, permission profiles, filesystem and network access, protected paths, auto-review, rules files (.rules) and prefix_rule, trusted projects

references/cli-commands.md.covers: Terminal subcommands, command-line options, -c overrides, sessions (resume, fork, archive, delete), slash commands, CLI customization

references/mcp.md.covers: [mcp_servers.<name>] tables in config.toml, STDIO and streamable HTTP transports, OAuth, tool filtering, timeouts, codex mcp commands

references/hooks.md.covers: Hook sources (hooks.json and config.toml), file format, handler types, events, matchers, input payloads, decision output, trust and review of hooks, debugging

references/skills.md.covers: SKILL.md format, skill locations and precedence, agents/openai.yaml metadata, enabling and disabling skills, invocation

references/agents-plugins.md.covers: Subagents and the [agents] table, custom agent TOML files, plugins, marketplaces, plugin.json, codex plugin commands, [plugins.*] enablement

references/instructions.md.covers: AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md discovery and layering, global instructions in CODEX_HOME, fallback filenames, project_doc_max_bytes
